prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, for the issuance of Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents 1 to 3 to take action under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007 and the Tamil Nadu Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Rules, 2009 and restore the petitioner's possession the house bearing D. No. 1/125, Main Road, East Valady, Lalgudi Taluk, Trichy District.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.S. Sundar, J.:— When the matter is taken up today for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prayer sought for in this writ petition is only for maintenance under the Maintenance and Welfare of Parents and Senior Citizens Act, 2007. It is further stated that the petitioner passed away. Therefore, he represented that the writ petition is become infructuous.

2. Therefore, this writ petition is dismissed as infructuous. No costs.
